name: algolia
label: Algolia
description: Search indices — list them, search them, and refresh one from a feed the moment a record changes.
author: scott@cookwithcarbon.com

descriptor.details: An app's search index is a separate store that ingests on a schedule, so between a write and the next ingest a record is real everywhere except where people look for it. This lists what each index holds and when it last built, searches one to reproduce a query that failed, pushes individual records, and replaces a whole index from a JSON feed atomically. Every write waits for the index to publish before answering, so "refreshed" means the next search will find it.
use_cases: A part was just created but the costing picker can't find it — refresh the index
Check when the parts index last built and whether anything is still pending
Run the exact search that came back empty, against the index that answered it

fields.label: Application ID
fields.description: From the Algolia dashboard, under Settings → API Keys.

fields.label: Admin API Key
fields.description: The key with write access. A Search-Only key lists and searches but cannot refresh anything — Algolia refuses it with "Method not allowed with this API key".

fields.label: Feed username
fields.description: Only if the feed a refresh pulls from is behind basic auth, as Proluxe's /algolia/* endpoints are.

fields.label: Feed token URL
fields.description: Only if the feed is behind OAuth2 client credentials, as the Proluxe gateway is. The token endpoint, e.g. https://proluxe-portal.auth0.com/oauth/token.

fields.label: Feed client secret
fields.description: Paired with the client ID above.

fields.label: Feed token audience
fields.description: Omit it and Auth0 returns a real but opaque token the gateway then declines — which reads exactly like a wrong secret.

sends.purpose: Search terms, and the records being indexed — which are whatever the configured feed returns (on this install, the ERP's part, customer, contact, vendor and catalog lists). Nothing from conversations, files or accounts is attached.
A GET against one of the ERP's own /algolia/* feed endpoints, to read the records a refresh then pushes. Read-only; nothing is sent to the ERP.
A client-credentials exchange for a short-lived token that reads the ERP feed. The client id and secret configured for this package, and nothing else.
